sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static conditional: it requires ship-owned designIceCondition and shipCategory inputs, applies only to the thin first-year ice condition, permits category A as non-applicable, accepts category B, and rejects other declared categories. Canonical namespace, targets, paths, ranges, and SHACL structure are valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional logic: do not impose sh:hasValue nltl:thinFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions unconditionally on every ship. The requirement applies only when the ship's designIceCondition is that thin-first-year-ice condition and shipCategory is not polarShipCategoryA; in that case require shipCategory = polarShipCategoryB. Remove the sh:or alternatives, which incorrectly allow category A or C and make category C an alternative rather than a violation of the applicable rule. Retain ship-owned paths and use a direct-static SHACL constraint whose non-applicable cases pass without requiring a convenience applicability property.

Candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static conditional: it requires ship-owned designIceCondition and shipCategory inputs, applies only to the thin first-year ice condition, permits category A as non-applicable, accepts category B, and rejects other declared categories. Canonical namespace, targets, paths, ranges, and SHACL structure are valid.
